notes: NEW subject pack: Linguistics Basics — phonetics, phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, pragmatics, language acquisition, and sociolinguistics & language change, with which-idea, morpheme-count, minimal-pair, and syllable-count practice, never your assignment.

Detector V39 was trained and measured this run but HELD, not shipped: on the permanent frozen probe it caught 16 of 18 humanized texts, exactly the shipped V36’s 16 — the gate needs an improvement, not a tie — and its human false-flag rate ticked up slightly to 4.74% (from 4.66%), so V36 stays live until a round genuinely beats it. This round tested the leading idea from last time — giving the specialist that already catches 18 of 18 more weight — across 12 variants, and the answer is no: scaling its weight up only trades mixed-class recall for humanized catch, and the unscaled variant won. The two probe misses (noise pollution, microplastics in the ocean) barely moved for the fourth straight round. Next try: a second generator family for the humanized class.
